steps.name: full-7200-row-vpd-dataset-audit
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; CLIMATE_DATASET_WORKERS=6 PYTHONPATH="$PWD" .venv/bin/python tools/ml/run_climate_v6_dataset_audit.py; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('reports/ml/climate_v6_dataset_audit_seed1847_vpd.json')
d=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert d['audit']['ready_for_training'] is True
assert d['config']['families'] == 15
assert d['config']['rows'] == 7200
assert d['workers'] == 6
assert d['audit']['split_counts'] == {'train': 4800, 'validation': 1200, 'test': 1200}
assert d['audit']['humidity_mode_counts']['VPD'] > 0
for split in ('train','validation','test'):
    assert d['split_humidity_mode_counts'][split]['RH'] > 0
    assert d['split_humidity_mode_counts'][split]['VPD'] > 0
    for name, stats in d['label_coverage'][split].items():
        assert stats['active_count'] > 0, (split,name)
        assert stats['strong_count'] > 0, (split,name)
for name in ('humidifier','dehumidifier'):
    assert d['vpd_output_coverage'][name]['active_count'] > 0
    assert d['vpd_output_coverage'][name]['strong_count'] > 0
print('STAGE9B_REPORT_VALIDATION=PASS')
PY
.venv/bin/ruff check tools/ml/run_climate_v6_dataset_audit.py; git diff --check; git status --short
